reference_sql:
SELECT campaign_id, channel_id, start_date,
  LEAD(start_date) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY start_date, campaign_id) AS next_start_date
FROM campaigns
alternatives:
SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, c.start_date,
  (SELECT MIN(c2.start_date) FROM campaigns c2
   WHERE c2.channel_id = c.channel_id
     AND (c2.start_date > c.start_date OR (c2.start_date = c.start_date AND c2.campaign_id > c.campaign_id))) AS next_start_date
FROM campaigns c

SELECT campaign_id, channel_id, start_date,
  LAG(start_date) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY start_date DESC, campaign_id DESC) AS next_start_date
FROM campaigns

other_way.sql:
SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, c.start_date,
  (SELECT MIN(c2.start_date) FROM campaigns c2
   WHERE c2.channel_id = c.channel_id
     AND (c2.start_date > c.start_date OR (c2.start_date = c.start_date AND c2.campaign_id > c.campaign_id))) AS next_start_date
FROM campaigns c
other_way.tradeoff: The earliest later start from a subquery gives the same date, but the tie rule for same-day starts must be written by hand.
